address: Dogmersfield Park, Chalky Lane, Dogmersfield, Hook,RG27 8TD
bio: Four Seasons Hotel Hampshire's building is a historic restored Georgian manor house, just outside London, that seamlessly blends English country living with 21st-century modernity.  Afternoon Tea is served in the gorgeous Drawing Room and Library Lounge, offering a warm welcoming retreat for your Afternoon Tea experience. With beautiful earthy tones, comfortable armchairs and sofas, and solid oak tables, you can enjoy a regal experience. They serve Afternoon Tea with delicious finger sandwiches, an assortment of homemade pastries and snacks, and a selection of fine teas.  Located just one hour from central London and 50 minutes from Southampton, this venue provides picturesque countryside views without being too far from the city, making it a great destination for weekend breaks.
